title: John Lennon buys Steinway upright piano | 1979
content:
John Lennon ordered a Steinway & Sons upright piano on 15 January 1979.

Lennnon bought the ebonised F-15 piano from instrument dealer DE White for $3,670, plus $115 for the bench. It was delivered to the Dakota Building on 9 May.
